title: deploy/state/clean/request.json (version 1)
description: A clean-up the backend asks the host for. Written by the backend atomically (a temp file in the same dir, then rename) at /opt/synap/deploy/state/clean/request.json; run by the host door `synap clean-request` (synap-clean.path). One request at a time: the host takes it (renames it request.taken.json) before acting. Anything outside this schema is refused and runs nothing.

service.description: restart-service only. postgres and postgres-backup are never restarted.
